Trend row 'fără istoric comparabil' visible on all 4 cards, dark theme readable. (2) Mobile 390x844: grid uses `grid-cols-2` (2 columns), bottom nav rendered at y=781 (independent of summary cards at y=2854+), no overlap. (4) Admin Finanțe & Escrow (accessed via sidebar 'Financiar' group expand → 'Finanțe & Escrow' item; nav testid `admin-nav-finance`): 3 DS KpiCards (`finance-total-wallet` 216.640 RON, `finance-escrow` 30.200 RON, `finance-tx-count` 132) + export card with `export-transactions` (Tranzacții CSV) + Useri CSV, AI Insights card `finance-ai-insights` with escrow bullet, DataTable `top-wallets-card` shows 10 rows, search `top-wallets-card-search` filters 10→1 on 'Mihai', CSV `top-wallets-card-export` present, 'Tranzacții 30 zile (per tip)' card renders below. (5) Marketplace Partners `/admin/marketplace-partners`: 4 DS KpiCards (`mkt-kpi-total` 6, `mkt-kpi-active` 5, `mkt-kpi-leads` 8, `mkt-kpi-conversions` 0), `mkt-ai-insights` with partner-stats bullets + 'Rulează AI Copilot' button which OPENS `mkt-copilot-panel` (verified panel opens then closed via X button — DID NOT run Claude analysis per instructions), 'Adaugă partener' opens `mkt-form-modal` then closed cleanly, filters `filter-status` + `filter-tier` render as expected. (6) Regression /admin/analytics-growth still renders `ag-tab-bar` + `ag-ai-insights` (iter91 DS reference intact). ZERO console errors on all tested pages. Webpack compiled clean.

issues: The 'Astăzi ai:' summary renders far below the fold (y=2854+ on 390x844) because WelcomeChecklist + MaturityCard + Ghid de pornire + Recenzii + Configurare cont checklist all render before it. On mobile it takes 4-5 scrolls to reach the summary. Consider moving today-summary to top or promoting it above WelcomeChecklist for a specialist-focused newcomer, especially since Hick's Law rationale was to shorten cognitive load. Not a blocker — verified rendering + interactions work.

critical_code_review_comments: SpecialistDashboard.jsx L92 monthlyEarnings uses `String(...).slice(0,7) === now.toISOString().slice(0,7)` — this compares in UTC. A confirmed_at timestamp created late on the last day of the month in Bucharest tz (Europe/Bucharest) could fall into the next UTC month → excluded from 'Încasări luna aceasta'. Consider using local-tz month boundaries or backend-computed value. Currently returns 2.600 RON on the test account (works, just minor tz edge case).

SpecialistDashboard.jsx L168 wraps `spec-today-summary` in a `<div className="dark ...">` — the parent DashLayout for specialist already applies dark theme, so this extra `dark` class is harmless but redundant. Cosmetic.

AdminOverview.jsx L157-172 — `admin-ops-panels` uses inline `{opsOpen &&
...
}` conditional render, which is fine but means panels remount on every expand/collapse (e.g., AutopilotActivityCard fetches on every open). Consider using `hidden` attribute + CSS or keeping mounted with `display:none` if opening/closing frequently. Minor perf consideration.
AdminOverview.jsx L21 halfTrend returns null when prev === 0, so kpi-jobs trend shows 'fără istoric comparabil'. Consistent with iter91 behavior — acceptable.

MarketplacePartnersPage.jsx L142 close button (X icon) in CopilotPanel has no data-testid or aria-label — makes it harder to close via automated tests. Consider adding `data-testid="mkt-copilot-close"`. Same applies to `mkt-form-modal` close button.

AdminPlatformTools.jsx AdminFinance — sort click on 'Sold (RON)' column did not visibly flip order in test (initial descending state didn't switch to ascending after click on `<th>`). May be due to controlled state re-computing to same sort direction. Iter91 report also validated DataTable sort on analytics-growth; recommend a quick sanity check that `toggleSort` in DS index.jsx L250 correctly cycles asc/desc/none. Not a blocker — search + rendering + CSV work.
Positive: All 4 modules migrated to the Design System (KpiCard + AIInsightCard + DataTable) render consistently. Data-testids are complete and unique. Zero console errors across all tested routes.

Positive: Hick's Law implementation on specialist dashboard is clean — 4 clear actions replace the previous 4 static stats, and 2 of 4 cards are interactive (jobs/notifications). Ops panels collapsible on admin overview also reduces initial cognitive load.
